mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.title, h.description, h.class_id, h.course_id, h.teacher_id, h.publish_time, h.deadline, h.create_time, h.update_time, h.is_deleted, cl.class_name, co.course_name, t.name AS teacher_name FROM homework h LEFT JOIN `class` cl ON h.class_id = cl.id AND cl.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON h.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON h.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE h.id = #{id} AND h.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework (title, description, class_id, course_id, teacher_id, publish_time, deadline, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{classId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, NOW(), #{deadline}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE homework SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, deadline = #{deadline}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE homework SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
